title: James B. Martino
vital_facts: Baptized at age 17; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult
Married Jennie Marie Barron, 1973, Ogden Utah Temple; Five children:
BS in business from BYU in 1974
President and CEO, Chairman of Russell-Newman
Seminary Teacher, Bishop, Stake Young Men President, High Councilor, Stake Executive Secretary, Stake President, Area Seventy
President of the Venezuela Maracaibo Mission 2000 - 2003
Second Quorum of the Seventy 2009 - present
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
